msg.choice_unsupported: '{label}' isn't available on this version of Windows
msg.unsupported_build: Doesn't apply to this version of Windows
msg.foreign_user_apply: The app is running under a different administrator account: this would apply to that account, not to {user}
msg.foreign_user_undo: The app is running under a different administrator account: undoing would touch that account, not {user}'s
msg.foreign_user_remove: The app is running under a different administrator account: it would remove that account's apps, not {user}'s
msg.ucpd: Windows protects this setting (UCPD) and only lets its own tools change it. Alternatives: remove "Widgets" in Bloatware, or in the Group Policy Editor (gpedit.msc) set Windows Components → Widgets → "Allow Widgets" to Disabled.
msg.write_protected: {error}. Windows protects this value and won't let other programs change it, not even as administrator
msg.power_description: High and Ultimate Performance keep the processor from lowering its clock or entering power saving: it responds faster but uses more power and runs hotter. On laptops, use them only when plugged in.
msg.power_ultimate_new: Ultimate Performance (created from the Windows template)
msg.power_create_failed: Windows didn't allow creating the Ultimate Performance plan
msg.power_not_found: That power plan doesn't exist on this PC
msg.power_previous_gone: the previous plan no longer exists
msg.power_not_ours: the plan to delete isn't the Ultimate Performance plan the app created
msg.journal_unreadable_backup: The history couldn't be read ({error}). A copy was saved to {path} and a new one was started.
msg.journal_unreadable: The history couldn't be read ({error}) or backed up ({backup_error}).
msg.apps_not_restorable: Removed apps can't be restored from here: reinstall them from the Microsoft Store.
msg.journal_mismatch: The history doesn't match the catalog ({error}). Nothing was undone.
msg.journal_power_invalid: The power plan history isn't valid ({error}). Nothing was undone.
msg.winget_not_found: winget wasn't found. Install or update "App Installer" from the Microsoft Store.
msg.winget_timeout: winget didn't finish within {minutes} minutes and was cancelled
msg.winget_no_hash: The manifest doesn't include the installer hash
msg.app_not_in_catalog: The app isn't in the catalog
msg.package_not_found: winget couldn't find the package (already uninstalled?)
msg.key_missing: This service doesn't exist in this edition of Windows
msg.cleanup_foreign_user: The app is running under a different administrator account: it would clean that account's folders
msg.update_bad_format: The downloaded file isn't a P-Rune installer
msg.cleanup_unsafe: Couldn't clean up with user permissions, so nothing was deleted ({error})
msg.update_verify_message: Confirm it's you to install P-Rune {version}.
msg.update_not_verified: Your identity wasn't confirmed: nothing was installed.
msg.update_verify_failed: Couldn't ask Windows for confirmation: nothing was installed.
msg.update_unreachable: Couldn't check for updates: GitHub didn't respond. Check your connection and try again later.
msg.wmo_no_folder: Couldn't find the user's programs folder
msg.wmo_hash_mismatch: The download doesn't match the verified WMO release: nothing was installed.
msg.wmo_link: The WMO folder is a link to somewhere else: nothing was touched.
msg.wmo_close_first: WMO is open. Close it from the tray icon (right-click → Exit) and try again.
msg.wmo_foreign_user: The app is running under a different administrator account: WMO would be installed for that account, not for {user}
msg.wmo_no_shell: Couldn't open WMO without administrator rights: Windows Explorer isn't running.

ai.copilot_legacy.title: Turn off built-in Copilot (23H2)
ai.copilot_legacy.description: Policy for the built-in Copilot in 23H2. From 24H2 on, Copilot is an app: remove it from Bloatware.

ai.recall.title: Turn off Recall (snapshots)
ai.recall.description: Policy that stops Recall from saving snapshots of your activity. Only has an effect on Copilot+ PCs.

appearance.dark_mode.title: Dark mode
appearance.dark_mode.description: Dark mode for Windows and for apps.

appearance.faster_menus.title: Faster menus
appearance.faster_menus.description: Lowers the delay before submenus open from 400 ms to 100 ms.

appearance.no_transparency.title: No transparency effects
appearance.no_transparency.description: Turns off transparency (Mica/Acrylic). Helps on PCs with a weak GPU.

appearance.performance_visuals.title: Minimal visual effects
appearance.performance_visuals.description: Like "Adjust for best performance": no window and menu animations, shadows, fades, desktop peek or window contents while dragging. Text stays smoothed.

explorer.classic_context_menu.title: Classic context menu
explorer.classic_context_menu.description: Brings back the full right-click menu, without 'Show more options'.

explorer.compact_mode.title: Compact view
explorer.compact_mode.description: Reduces the spacing between items in File Explorer.

explorer.full_path_title.title: Don't 'prettify' names
explorer.full_path_title.description: Shows file and folder names exactly as written, without changing their case.

explorer.icons_not_thumbnails.title: Icons instead of thumbnails
explorer.icons_not_thumbnails.description: File Explorer doesn't generate previews of images and videos. Faster in large folders.

explorer.no_aero_shake.title: Turn off 'shake to minimize'
explorer.no_aero_shake.description: Shaking a window no longer minimizes all the others.

explorer.open_this_pc.title: Open to 'This PC'
explorer.open_this_pc.description: File Explorer opens to 'This PC' instead of 'Home'.

explorer.separate_process.title: Folders in a separate process
explorer.separate_process.description: If a File Explorer window hangs, it doesn't take the taskbar down with it. Uses a bit more RAM.

explorer.show_extensions.title: Show file extensions
explorer.show_extensions.description: Shows .exe, .pdf, etc. Recommended for security: that way 'invoice.pdf.exe' can't hide what it is.

explorer.show_hidden.title: Show hidden files
explorer.show_hidden.description: Shows hidden files and folders (not protected system files).

gaming.game_dvr.title: Turn off background recording (Game DVR)
gaming.game_dvr.description: Turns off Xbox Game Bar background capture. Can raise FPS on modest PCs.

gaming.mouse_acceleration.title: Turn off mouse acceleration
gaming.mouse_acceleration.description: Turns off 'Enhance pointer precision': movement becomes 1:1. Ideal for games.

gaming.sticky_keys_prompt.title: No Sticky Keys prompt (Shift x5)
gaming.sticky_keys_prompt.description: Pressing Shift five times no longer opens the Sticky Keys prompt in the middle of a game.

privacy.activity_history.title: Turn off activity history
privacy.activity_history.description: Your activity history (apps, files and websites you used) isn't stored or uploaded.

privacy.advertising_id.title: Turn off advertising ID
privacy.advertising_id.description: Stops apps from using your advertising ID for personalized ads.

privacy.inking_typing.title: Turn off inking and typing personalization
privacy.inking_typing.description: Windows stops collecting what you type and draw to build a personal dictionary.

privacy.online_speech.title: Turn off online speech recognition
privacy.online_speech.description: Your voice isn't sent to the cloud. Online dictation stops working.

privacy.tailored_experiences.title: Turn off tailored experiences
privacy.tailored_experiences.description: Microsoft stops using your diagnostic data for tailored tips and ads.

privacy.telemetry_policy.title: Minimal telemetry (policy)
privacy.telemetry_policy.description: Sets diagnostic data to the lowest level your edition allows. On Home and Pro the effective minimum is 'Required'.

privacy.track_app_launches.title: Don't track app launches
privacy.track_app_launches.description: Windows stops recording which apps you open to rank Start and search.

privacy.typing_insights.title: Turn off typing insights
privacy.typing_insights.description: Turns off the collection of typing statistics (Typing insights).

search.highlights.title: No search highlights
search.highlights.description: Removes the daily illustrations and topics from the search box.

search.taskbar_mode.title: Search on the taskbar
search.taskbar_mode.description: How search is shown: hidden, icon only, icon with label, or the full search box.

search.web_results.title: No Bing web results in search
search.web_results.description: Policy that turns off web suggestions in Start search. Searches stay local only.

start.account_notifications.title: Hide account notifications in Start
start.account_notifications.description: Removes 'Complete your Microsoft account' / 'Back up' style notices from the Start menu.

start.finish_setup_nag.title: No 'Let's finish setting up your device'
start.finish_setup_nag.description: Turns off the screen that keeps pushing OneDrive, Microsoft 365 and a Microsoft account.

start.lockscreen_tips.title: No fun facts on the lock screen
start.lockscreen_tips.description: Removes tips and 'fun facts' from the lock screen.

start.recommendations.title: Hide recommendations and tips in Start
start.recommendations.description: Removes promotional recommendations (Iris) from the Start menu.

start.settings_suggestions.title: No suggested content in Settings
start.settings_suggestions.description: Removes suggestions and promotions from the Settings app.

start.silent_installs.title: Block silent installs of suggested apps
start.silent_installs.description: Stops Windows from installing promoted games and apps (Candy Crush & co.) without asking.

start.suggested_notifications.title: No 'suggested' notifications
start.suggested_notifications.description: Silences system notifications that suggest features and apps.

start.suggestions.title: No suggestions in Start
start.suggestions.description: Turns off the suggested apps that show up in the Start menu.

start.sync_provider_ads.title: No ads in File Explorer
start.sync_provider_ads.description: Removes sync provider notices (OneDrive, Microsoft 365) from File Explorer.

start.tips.title: No tips and tricks
start.tips.description: Turns off 'tips, tricks and suggestions' notifications.

start.welcome_experience.title: No 'welcome experience' after updates
start.welcome_experience.description: Skips the what's-new screen after updates.

taskbar.align_left.title: Align icons to the left
taskbar.align_left.description: Start button and icons on the left, like in Windows 10.

taskbar.clock_seconds.title: Show seconds on the clock
taskbar.clock_seconds.description: The taskbar clock shows seconds. Uses a little more battery.

taskbar.disable_widgets.title: Turn off Widgets
taskbar.disable_widgets.description: Policy that fully turns off the Widgets board (news, weather, MSN).

taskbar.end_task.title: 'End task' on right-click
taskbar.end_task.description: Adds 'End task' to the context menu of apps on the taskbar.

taskbar.hide_task_view.title: Hide the Task View button
taskbar.hide_task_view.description: Removes the Task View button (Win+Tab still works).

taskbar.no_animations.title: No taskbar animations
taskbar.no_animations.description: Turns off taskbar animations. It feels snappier.

services.diagtrack.title: Turn off the telemetry service (DiagTrack)
services.diagtrack.description: Stops "Connected User Experiences and Telemetry", the service that sends diagnostic data to Microsoft.

services.wap_push.title: Turn off the WAP Push message routing service
services.wap_push.description: Device push message service, used mostly alongside telemetry. A regular PC won't miss it.

services.maps.title: Turn off Downloaded Maps Manager
services.maps.description: Only the Maps app (discontinued) used it for offline maps.

services.retail_demo.title: Turn off the Retail Demo service
services.retail_demo.description: Only used for the showroom mode of PCs on display in stores.

services.fax.title: Turn off the Fax service
services.fax.description: Service to send and receive faxes. Many editions of Windows 11 no longer include it.

services.error_reporting.title: Turn off Windows Error Reporting
services.error_reporting.description: Windows stops collecting and sending reports when a program crashes. Doesn't affect normal use.

services.insider.title: Turn off the Windows Insider service
services.insider.description: Only needed to get preview builds from the Insider program.

services.xbox.title: Turn off the Xbox services
services.xbox.description: Xbox sign-in, cloud saves, networking and accessories. Breaks Microsoft Store / Game Pass games, the Xbox Game Bar and Xbox controller configuration.

services.print_spooler.title: Turn off the Print Spooler
services.print_spooler.description: If you don't use a printer: it also closes a well-known attack path (PrintNightmare). With it off you can't print or save as PDF with Microsoft Print to PDF.

services.geolocation.title: Turn off the location service
services.geolocation.description: Apps no longer know where the PC is. Breaks local weather, Find my device and automatic time zone.

services.sysmain.title: Turn off SysMain (Superfetch)
services.sysmain.description: Stops preloading your most-used apps into RAM. Barely noticeable with an SSD; with a hard drive, apps take longer to open.

Microsoft.GamingApp.title: Xbox
Microsoft.GamingApp.note: Needed to install PC Game Pass games.

Microsoft.OutlookForWindows.title: Outlook (new)
Microsoft.OutlookForWindows.note: Replaces Mail and Calendar. Only remove it if you use another email client.

Microsoft.Windows.Photos.title: Photos
Microsoft.Windows.Photos.note: It's the default image viewer. Install another one before removing it.

Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay.title: Xbox Game Bar
Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay.note: Some games use it for captures and chat.

Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider.title: Xbox Identity Provider
Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider.note: Xbox sign-in: without it, Microsoft Store games can't sign in.

MicrosoftCorporationII.QuickAssist.title: Quick Assist
MicrosoftCorporationII.QuickAssist.note: It's the remote support tool scammers use the most. Removing it lowers that risk.

MicrosoftWindows.Client.WebExperience.title: Widgets (Windows Web Experience Pack)
MicrosoftWindows.Client.WebExperience.note: Removes the Widgets board (news, weather, MSN). It can be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store as "Windows Web Experience Pack".

app.7zip.7zip: Compresses and extracts zip, 7z, rar and more.
app.AntibodySoftware.WizTree: Shows what's taking up disk space, very fast.
app.Brave.Brave: Chromium-based, with built-in ad and tracker blocking.
app.Flow-Launcher.Flow-Launcher: Quick launcher for apps and files with Alt+Space.
app.LibreWolf.LibreWolf: Firefox with hardened privacy out of the box.
app.Microsoft.PowerShell: The modern version of PowerShell, side by side with 5.1.
app.Microsoft.PowerToys: Official Microsoft utilities: FancyZones, Color Picker, PowerRename…
app.Notepad++.Notepad++: Lightweight text editor with syntax highlighting.
app.Obsidian.Obsidian: Markdown notes with links between them.
app.RamenSoftware.Windhawk: Mods to customize Windows in depth. Some antivirus programs flag it, and it's best to exclude games with anti-cheat.
app.ShareX.ShareX: Screenshots and screen recordings with quick editing.
app.SumatraPDF.SumatraPDF: Very lightweight PDF and ebook reader.
app.TheDocumentFoundation.LibreOffice: Free office suite: documents, spreadsheets and presentations.
app.VideoLAN.VLC: Plays almost any audio and video format.
